messages.content: Help me verify if an email address 'example@domain.com' conforms to the standard email format, optionally allowing for custom domain validation with 'domain.com'?

function.name: emailFormatValidator
function.description: This function validates if a given email address adheres to the standard email format and can optionally check against specific domain criteria. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

email.description: The email address to validate against the standard email format. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

domain.description: An optional parameter for domain-specific validation. Default is an empty string, which means no custom domain validation. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning: The user wants to validate an email address 'example@domain.com' against standard email format, optionally allowing for custom domain validation with 'domain.com'. The user explicitly says "optionally allowing for custom domain validation with 'domain.com'". That means we should pass domain param as 'domain.com'. The user wants to validate the email address. The user has provided the email address 'example@domain.com' and domain 'domain.com'. So we can call the function with email: 'example@domain.com', domain: 'domain.com'. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we can call the function.
